title: Облачная обсерватория
palette: Peach and lavender cloudstone, pearly pink terraces, pale gold instruments, mauve shrubs and cool periwinkle inlays. Soft pastel celestial world, no green/mint Mediterranean garden.
terrain: Stacked broad rounded cloudstone ledges offset diagonally like a sculpted spiral hillside but with a winding cross-island circuit, connected by thick wide gently sloping saddles. No circular race track or concentric rings.
landmarks: An off-center OPEN low gold observatory pavilion with thick ribs, a shallow pearly cloudwell fountain, one lavender natural arch and three sculpted mauve shrubs. No tall castle or central domed tower.
road: Wide muted periwinkle stone-inlaid trail across peach terraces, gentle smooth ramps with no steps; ample pale shoulders.
journey: Bend between offset ledges, travel through the lavender arch into the interior, sweep beside the cloudwell, cross a broad saddle below the gold pavilion, then reverse curve toward a different edge. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Airy sculptural ceramic shapes and satin celestial metals, clear thick modelable structures.
architecture: Preserve SOUTHEAST open low gold observatory pavilion. Add NORTHWEST peach-ceramic radio workshop with lavender roof, chunky brass vents and short aerial; SOUTHWEST mauve courier home; low periwinkle relay plinth on NORTHEAST ledge with one gold dish. Central cloudwell and short lavender stone arch remain. Low legible buildings, no generic castle.
